font-mono.value: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Monaco, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace

font-sans.value: system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif

shadow-md.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 20px 25px -5px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 10px 10px -5px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 4%, transparent)

shadow-sm.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 10px 15px -5px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 7px 7px -5px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 4%, transparent)

shadow-xl.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 36px 28px -7px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 17px 17px -7px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 4%, transparent)

shadow-xs.value: 0 1px 3px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 5%, transparent), 0 1px 2px color-mix(in srgb, #000000 10%, transparent)
